exact_statement: IDD maps each distribution to the tangent space at the pre-change Frechet barycenter using the quadratic-Wasserstein radial isometry, then computes MFPCA Hotelling T2 and SPE statistics in that common tangent space.
source_anchors: main0.tex:516-570 (empirical covariance, Equation T2-mf, Equation SPE)
assumptions: The reference measure is absolutely continuous and belongs to P2(R^d).
The cost is squared Euclidean distance.
Each tested transport is the unique Brenier map from the common reference.
Phase-I centering and covariance use only the 300 pre-change fields.
acceptance: Six independently solved empirical OT problems match the known Brenier maps and radial norms to 1e-9.
An independent Gram-matrix eigendecomposition reproduces eigenvalues, T2, and SPE within declared tolerances.
Identity-map, wrong-reference/nonoptimal-plan, and unscaled-Hotelling controls are all rejected.
The two-chart monitor alarms on at least 90 percent of the predeclared changed half.
